# RSVP status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:rsvpStatus`](gmeow-rsvpStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/rsvpStatus>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/calendar`](../../slices/calendar.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The RSVP response status as asserted by the invitee — needs-action, accepted, declined, tentative. Distinct from [`invitationStatus`](gmeow-invitationStatus.md): the organizer's view and the invitee's view may disagree, and both claims coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:EventInvitation`](../classes/gmeow-EventInvitation.md) -> [`gmeow:RsvpStatus`](../classes/gmeow-RsvpStatus.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:rsvpStatus`](gmeow-rsvpStatus.md) from [`gmeow:EventInvitation`](../classes/gmeow-EventInvitation.md) to [`gmeow:RsvpStatus`](../classes/gmeow-RsvpStatus.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Recurring Meeting

- **Source:** [`slices/core/calendar/examples/recurring-meeting.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/calendar/examples/recurring-meeting.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-calendar-examples-recurring-meeting)#example-slices-core-calendar-examples-recurring-meeting

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: a recurring meeting with invitations. A gmeow:EventSchedule
# repeats a TEMPLATE event by a gmeow:RecurrenceRule (an RFC 5545 RRULE string),
# all anchored in an explicit gmeow:TimeZone (IANA id) — so "every Monday 09:00"
# is unambiguous across DST. Invitations are reified gmeow:EventInvitations
# carrying both the organiser-side gmeow:invitationStatus and the invitee's own
# gmeow:rsvpStatus. The event's kind is an open vocabulary: there is no seed
# "meeting" EventType, so one is minted (the custom-value idiom, P9).
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/calendar/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

# --- A reified invitation: organiser status AND the invitee's own RSVP.
ex:invite a gmeow:EventInvitation ;
    gmeow:invitationEvent   ex:standup ;
    gmeow:invitationInvitee ex:dana ;
    gmeow:invitationStatus  gmeow:invitationStatusAccepted ;
    gmeow:rsvpStatus        gmeow:rsvpStatusAccepted .
```

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the INVITEE's own response to an invitation — the reply the recipient asserts, which may differ from the organizer's [`gmeow:invitationStatus`](gmeow-invitationStatus.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the organizer's record (that is [`gmeow:invitationStatus`](gmeow-invitationStatus.md)) and avoid forcing the two views to agree; they coexist as distinct claims ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Set a [`gmeow:RsvpStatus`](../classes/gmeow-RsvpStatus.md) value for the invitee's reply; when organizer and invitee disagree, standpoint-index each via [`accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) rather than choosing a winner.

### Examples

- ex:standupInvite [`gmeow:rsvpStatus`](gmeow-rsvpStatus.md) [`gmeow:rsvpStatusTentative`](../individuals/gmeow-rsvpStatusTentative.md).
